protocol.candidate: Fixed market log odds plus four standardized external features; no fitted intercept or market slope
protocol.fitting: L2 .1, bounds +/-.25, training-only scaling unchanged; no tuning
protocol.stress: Fit on current inputs, delay external inputs only at inference, keep current market quote
protocol.trade: Same 1000 bankroll, 1% sizing, .04 net edge, .02 slippage, .07 fee coefficient
protocol.gate: Both Brier and log loss beat both market controls in >=3 of 4 folds and pooled; positive net P&L, >=30 trades and >=10 trade days; never automatic deployment/holdout release
limitations: Historical arrival times unavailable; delay is a scenario
June fee coefficient assumed; no override audit
